snippet.title: Escape By Spoon - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
You are a prisoner in the strangest prison, armed with nothing but a spoon and one simple goal: escape
Dig beneath your cell, cook whatever you can catch, and fight anything standing between you and freedom.

Wishlist On Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4298700/Escape_By_Spoon/
